verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show the Apache-2.0 `livekit-server` booting locally with no account or key, and the open-source `livekit-agents` package installing and importing keylessly. First-party self-hosting deployment docs cover TURN, domain and SSL requirements, and open-source plugins let agents call model providers directly instead of using LiveKit Cloud Inference. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of running the agent worker runtime at production scale on self-managed infrastructure (the probe only verified dev mode).
